onesa_matter.title: Nei Onesa AI Inokosha
onesa_matter.headline: Africa inokodzera AI inonzwisisa Africa.
onesa_matter.p1: Pasi rese, AI iri kugadzirisa hupfumi, maindasitiri, uye nzanga nekumhanya kunoshamisa. Zvakadaro mamodheru mazhinji akavakirwa pane data, zvinonyanya kukosha, uye mamiriro anowanzo kupotsa chokwadi cheAfrica. Kuti Africa itore chikamu zvizere muupfumi hwepasi rose hwedhijitari, tinoda mhando dzeAfrica-centric dzinonzwisisa mitauro yedu, tsika, nharaunda dzebhizinesi, uye zvinotungamira mubudiriro.
onesa_matter.p2: KuDiaspora Yakavhurwa, tinotenda Africa haifanire kungodya AI. Africa inofanirwa kubatsira kuivaka. Kutenda ikoko ndicho chikonzero chakaita kuti titange kugadzira Onesa AI: kugadzira masisitimu ane hungwaru anonyatsoenderana nemisika yeAfrica, nzvimbo dze data dzeAfrica, uye zvinangwa zvekushandura hupfumi hweAfrica.
onesa_matter.p3: Tinoziva zvakare kuti rwendo urwu haruna nyore. Kudzidzisa AI modhi kunoda zvakakomba zvivakwa, simba rekombuta, kugadzirira data, uye tarenda repasi rose. Mari yacho yakakwirira, uye zvipingamupinyi ndezvechokwadi. Isu takasarudza kuenderera mberi zvakadaro nekuti ramangwana reAfrica renguva refu rinoenderana nehunyanzvi hwehunyanzvi, rusununguko rwedhijitari, uye kugona kuumba yedu yedhijitari ecosystem.
onesa_matter.p4: Hutongi hweAI huri kuita imwe yekutsanangura hurukuro dzepasi rose dzenguva ino. Nyika dzinodzora data radzo, mamodheru, uye zvivakwa zvedhijitari zvichange zvakamisikidzwa zvirinani kuchengetedza hupfumi hwavo, kusimudzira hunyanzvi, uye kuchengetedza rusununguko. Africa inofanirwa kunge iri mune ramangwana, kwete sevacherechedzi, asi sevasiki nevatungamiriri.
onesa_matter.p5: Onesa AI kuzvipira kwedu kune iro ramangwana. Izvi zvakakura kudarika tekinoroji. Zviri pamusoro pemukana, kusimba, uye kuvaka masisitimu anoshandira zvizvarwa zvinotevera mukondinendi yese nediaspora.

compliance_checklist.c1: Confirm your product HS code and check EU duties/technical measures in Access2Markets.
compliance_checklist.c2: Register for REX with ZIMRA if exporting consignments above EUR 6,000 under iEPA preferences.
compliance_checklist.c3: Issue a valid Statement on Origin for each shipment.
compliance_checklist.c4: Prepare invoice, packing list, transport document, and sector-specific export licenses.
compliance_checklist.c5: Complete SPS, labeling, and traceability controls required for your product class.
compliance_checklist.c6: For carbon-intensive goods, assess CBAM exposure and reporting obligations ahead of 2026.

registration.title: Key Registration and Documentation
registration.subtitle: Core steps required to claim preferential access and clear EU import controls.

rex.r1: Exports to the EU are governed by the interim EPA (iEPA), giving Zimbabwe duty-free and quota-free market access.
rex.r2: Since July 1, 2021, exporters must use the EU Registered Exporter (REX) self-certification system.
rex.r3: Register as an exporter through ZIMRA to issue valid Statements on Origin under REX.

origin.r1: Consignments above EUR 6,000 require a Statement on Origin from a registered REX exporter.
origin.r2: Consignments at or below EUR 6,000 can be self-certified by any exporter (without REX registration).
origin.r3: Keep origin documentation audit-ready for customs checks in both Zimbabwe and the EU.

zimra.r1: Typical ZIMRA registration pack includes application letter, certificate of incorporation, CR6/CR14, and valid ITF263 tax clearance.
zimra.r2: Obtain an export license where required by sector ministries (for example Agriculture for plants).
zimra.r3: Core shipping file must include commercial invoice (with HS code), packing list, and bill of lading/air waybill.

sps.r1: Food and plant exports must meet strict SPS requirements, including traceability and health controls.
sps.r2: Market trust often depends on certifications such as GLOBALG.A.P. and HACCP.
sps.r3: For honey, compliance work includes a National Residue Monitoring Plan (NRMP) aligned to EU requirements.

vicfalls.name: Mapopoma eVhitori
vicfalls.desc: Chimwe chezvishamiso zvinomwe zvenyika, mapopoma makuru pasi rose
vicfalls.summary: Inozivikanwa nemuno seMosi-oa-Tunya (Utsi Hunotinhira), Victoria Falls yakapetwa kaviri pakukwirira kune Niagara Falls. Nakidzwa nekukwira magwa, bungee jumping, nhabvu dzemundege, uye Devil's Pool inozivikanwa kwazvo.
quickFacts: Located on the Zambezi River at the Zimbabwe-Zambia border.
Approximate width is 1.7 km with a drop of over 100 m at its deepest sections.
Protected within the Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls World Heritage landscape.
experiences: Scenic viewpoints, rainforest walks, and photography trails.
Adventure options such as rafting, bungee jumping, and helicopter flights.
Nearby safari and river experiences in surrounding protected areas.
vicfalls.bestTime: High-water spectacle is usually strongest from late rainy season into early dry season; lower-water months are often preferred for some adventure activities.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Masvingo ekare anoratidza budiriro nehunyanzvi hwekuvaka hweAfrica
greatzim.summary: Yakavakwa pakati pezana ramakore rechi11 nerechi15, Great Zimbabwe ndiyo yaive guta guru reUmambo hweZimbabwe. Masvingo aya akavakwa nemabwe pasina dhaka. Nzvimbo iyi ndiyo yakapa nyika zita rayo.
quickFacts: Constructed and expanded between the 11th and 15th centuries.
Famous for dry-stone masonry built without mortar.
Represents the political and cultural center of the historic Zimbabwe civilization.
experiences: Explore the Hill Complex, Great Enclosure, and Valley Ruins.
Interpretive historical tours and local cultural storytelling.
Panoramic viewpoints over the wider Masvingo landscape.
greatzim.bestTime: Accessible year-round; dry season months are generally better for walking and site exploration.

kariba.name: Dhamu reKariba
kariba.desc: Rimwe remadziva makuru akaitwa nevanhu, rakanakira kukwira magwa nekuredza hove
kariba.summary: Dziva reKariba rakakura kudarika 5,500 square kilometers parwizi rwaZambezi. Rakakurumbira nekuredza tiger fish, maholide emagwa (houseboats), nekuvira kwezuva kunoyevedza.
quickFacts: Sits on the Zambezi corridor and supports both tourism and recreation.
Popular for boat-based travel, fishing tourism, and sunset cruises.
Connected to nearby wildlife areas including Matusadona-facing zones.
experiences: Game-viewing combinations with lake and park circuits.
kariba.bestTime: Dry season is typically preferred for wildlife viewing; lake activities operate across most of the year.

rocks.name: Mabwe Anoshamisa
rocks.summary: Mabwe aya anoonekwa pamari yeZimbabwe uye anowanikwa munyika yose, zvikuru muMatobo National Park. Akasikwa nemamiriro ekunze mukufamba kwemakore akawanda.
quickFacts: Prominent around Matobo and other granite landscapes.
Featured in national symbolism, including currency imagery.
Formed through weathering and erosion of ancient granite outcrops.
experiences: Landscape photography and short nature walks.
Rock-art and heritage combinations in Matobo areas.
Scenic drives linking Harare and Matobo viewpoints.
rocks.bestTime: Year-round attraction; clear dry-season weather often gives the best visibility for photos.

Iyo kambani yakagadzira nharembozha yekubhadhara mhinduro yenzvimbo dzekumaruwa, ikozvino inoshandira 500K+ vashandisi. Diaspora investimendi vakapa zvese capital uye technical mentorship.

honey_export.title: Huchi Export Cooperative
honey_export.story: Vapfuri nyuchi vekumaruwa vakaumba mubatanidzwa wekutengesa huchi hwepasi kuEurope. Diaspora chikafu masayendisiti akabatsira kuwana EU certification, nepo diaspora bhizinesi nyanzvi dzakachengetedza zvibvumirano neakasarudzika ezvitoro zvekudya. Mushandirapamwe uyu zvino unotsigira mhuri zana nemakumi maviri.
honey_export.testimonial: Kubva pakutengesa uchi padivi pemugwagwa kuenda kune dzimwe nyika kuzvitoro zvikuru zvekuEurope—network yediaspora yakaita kuti shanduko iyi ikwanisike kuburikidza nerutsigiro rwehunyanzvi uye kubatana kwemusika.

heritage_tourism.title: Heritage Tourism Package Kubudirira

Iwo mapakeji anosanganisa kushanya kwemhuri nekushanya kwetsika, kukwezva vanopfuura 1,200 diaspora vashanyi pagore. Bhizinesi rinoshandisa vatungamiriri venzvimbo, vatyairi, uye vashandi vekugamuchira vaenzi.
heritage_tourism.testimonial: Isu takagadzira zviitiko zvinobatsira diaspora kuti ibatane nemidzi yavo tichitsigira nharaunda. Chikuva cheZIGD chakatipa kuoneka kumusika wedu watinoda.

macadamia_nut.title: Macadamia Nut Processing Plant
macadamia_nut.story: Kuwana mari kubva kudiaspora kwakaita kuti pavakwe chivako chekutanga chekugadzira macadamia muZimbabwe. Nzvimbo iyi inogadzira nzungu kubva ku200+ varimi vadiki, vachiwedzera kukosha vasati vatumira kunze kwenyika. Zvibvumirano zvekutenga zvehurumende zvinopa kudiwa kwakagadzikana nepo misika yekunze ichifambisa kukura.
macadamia_nut.testimonial: Takakwidza $1.2M kubva kune diaspora investimendi vaitenda mukukosha-kuwedzera. Ikozvino tiri kugadzira mabasa, kutsigira varimi, uye kutumira zvigadzirwa zvekutanga kuAsia neEurope.

stories_list.title: Tech Startup Diaspora Funding
stories_list.story: A Harare-based fintech startup raised $750K from diaspora investors through Diaspora Unlocked's investment platform. The company developed a mobile payment solution for rural areas, now serving 500K+ users. Diaspora investors provided both capital and technical mentorship.
stories_list.testimonial: Diaspora funding came with more than money—we gained advisors who understood Silicon Valley standards and African market realities. Their guidance was invaluable.
stories_list.author: Tafadzwa Chidavaenzi

stories_list.title: Honey Export Cooperative
stories_list.story: Rural beekeepers formed a cooperative to export organic honey to Europe. Diaspora food scientists helped achieve EU certification, while diaspora business professionals secured contracts with specialty food retailers. The cooperative now supports 120 families.
stories_list.testimonial: From selling honey by the roadside to exporting to European supermarkets—the diaspora network made this transformation possible through technical support and market connections.
stories_list.author: Rudo Makoni

stories_list.title: Heritage Tourism Package Success
stories_list.story: A tourism operator developed specialized diaspora homecoming packages through Diaspora Unlocked's platform. The packages combine family visits with cultural tourism, attracting over 1,200 diaspora tourists annually. The business employs local guides, drivers, and hospitality staff.
stories_list.testimonial: We created experiences that help diaspora reconnect with their roots while supporting local communities. Diaspora Unlocked's platform gave us visibility to our target market.
stories_list.author: Chipo Mutasa

stories_list.title: Macadamia Nut Processing Plant
stories_list.story: Diaspora crowdfunding enabled construction of Zimbabwe's first macadamia processing plant. The facility processes nuts from 200+ small-scale farmers, adding value before export. Government procurement contracts provide stable demand while export markets drive growth.
stories_list.testimonial: We raised $1.2M from diaspora investors who believed in value-addition. Now we're creating jobs, supporting farmers, and exporting premium products to Asia and Europe.
stories_list.author: Ngoni Sibanda

regulations.title: Gwara reMitemo neKutevedzera
regulations.subtitle: Mirayiridzo inoshanda yemitemo kune vadyari vediaspora, vatengesi vekunze, nevadzoki kumusha. Shandisai izvi serunyoro rwekuita basa, uye enzanisai zvisarudzo zvekupedzisira nenyanzvi dzemutemo, mutero, nechikamu chebhizimusi.

investment_compliance.title: Kutevedzera mitemo pakudyara
points: Simbisa chimiro chepamutemo chechirongwa, varidzi, uye hutungamiri hwebhodhi usati wapa mari.
Tarisa marezinesi nemvumo kuburikidza neZIDA nevatariri vechikamu vane basa.
Shandisa zvibvumirano zvakanyorwa zvevane migove nehutungamiri pakudyara pamwe chete nediaspora.
Nyora kwakabva mari uye ita KYC/AML kuvanhu kana masangano amuri kushanda nawo.

currency_settlement.title: Mari, kudzorerwa kwemari, nekubhadhara
points: Bvumiranai mari yekubhadhara (USD/ZiG/zvimwe) nenguva dzekubhadhara muzvibvumirano.
Tsanangurai zvakajeka migove (dividends) nenzira dzekubuda kune vanotora chikamu vediaspora.
Shandisa nzira dzemabhanga dzinoenderana nemitemo uye dzinotevedzeka pakufamba kwemari.
Isa zvinobata njodzi dzeFX nekutamiswa kwemari mumagwaro ekudyara (term sheets).

export_controls.title: Kudzorwa kwekutengesa kunze
points: Simbisa HS classification, zvinorambidzwa mumusika wekuenda, nemvumo inodiwa.
Chengetedza mapakeji ezvitupa: mavambo, phytosanitary, nemagwaro ehunhu.
Enzanisa kunyora pamapakeji, kupakata, nekutevedza chigadzirwa nemitemo yemusika wekuenda.
Shandisa vanotakura zvinhu necustoms broker vakabvumidzwa pazvigadzirwa zvinodzorwa.

export_certification_and_labeling.title: Zvitupa nekulebhela
points: Mapa chigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe kumazinga anodiwa musati matanga kushanda nevatengi.
Ita pre-audit yenzvimbo nemagwaro usati waenda kuongororo yezvitupa zvekunze.
Chengetedza lot-level traceability yezvekudya, wellness, nezvigadzirwa zvemaoko zvinotengeswa kunze.
Ita ongororo dzenguva nenguva dzekutevedzera mitemo kudzivirira kuvharirwa pamuganhu nezvirango.

tourism_entry_and_safety.title: Kupinda munyika nekuchengeteka kwekushanya
points: Tarisa rudzi rwevisa, nguva inobvumidzwa yekugara, uye kushanda kwemagwaro usati wafamba.
Iva neinishuwarenzi yerwendo inoenderana nemabasa aunoronga nezvinodiwa zveutano.
Simbisa nzira dzekubhadhara nemiganhu yekutengeserana kare.
Tevedza mitemo yemuno yemapaki, migwagwa, nezvekugara.

due_diligence_checklist.title: Runyorwa rweDue Diligence rweDiaspora
points: Kuongorora kambani, UBO checks, pamwe nekuongorora nyaya dzematare kana zvirango.
Kuongorora zvibvumirano pazvekutengeserana, mutero, nekugadzirisa kupokana.
Uchapupu hwekushanda: kushanya kwenzvimbo, mabhuku emari akaongororwa, nekuongorora vatengesi.
Kudzora kunoenderera: nguva dzemishumo, kutevera KPI, uye matrix yekukwidziridza nyaya.
